content_text:
WE'RE HIRING - CASUAL ENGINEERING OFFICERS!
Join Torres Strait Island Regional Council (TSIRC) and make a difference in your community!
Are you hands-on, reliable and enjoy working outdoors? TSIRC is seeking motivated and hardworking individuals to join our Engineering Services Team in casual positions across our island communities.
Casual Opportunities Available at the following Divisions:
- 1 x Division 3 - Saibai
- 1 x Division 4 - Mabuiag
- 2 x Division 6 - Kubin
- 2 x Division 7 - St Paul's 
- 1 x Division 14 - Erub
- 2 x Division 15 - Mer
About the Role
As a Casual Engineering Officer, you will work alongside and support our full-time Engineering Officers in the day-to-day operation and maintenance of Council's essential infrastructure and community facilities.
Your duties will include:
- Assisting with maintenance of roads, parks, gardens and public facilities.
- Supporting water and wastewater operations.
- Assisting with waste collection and management.
- Helping maintain airport and marine facilities.
- Operating tools, machinery and equipment safely.
- Undertaking general maintenance and civil works as required.
Mandatory Requirements:
- Must hold a current Queensland Class "C" Driver's Licence (Provisional or higher).
- Current Construction White Card. 
This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience, develop practical skills and contribute to keeping your community safe, clean and well-maintained.
Applying:
Please submit an updated resume and a cover letter stating your preferred work location and outlining your skills, experience, qualifications and personal attributes most relevant to the position by Friday, 23 October 2026.
For more information contact David Mosby on 0407 859 568.
TSIRC is an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
